title: Positional Encoding via Token-Aware Phase Attention
abstract: arXiv:2509.12635v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We prove under practical assumptions that Rotary Positional Embedding (RoPE) introduces an intrinsic distance-dependent bias in attention scores that limits RoPE's ability to model long-context. RoPE extension methods may alleviate this issue, but they typically require post-hoc adjustments after pretraining, such as rescaling or hyperparameters retuning. This paper introduces Token-Aware Phase Attention (TAPA), a new positional encoding method that incorporates a learnable phase function into the attention mechanism. TAPA preserves token interactions over long range, extends to longer contexts with direct and light continual pretraining, extrapolates to unseen lengths, and attains substantially lower perplexity and stronger retrieval performance in the long-context regime than RoPE-style baselines.

translated_title: 基于词元感知相位注意力的位置编码
translated_abstract: 我们在实际假设条件下证明，旋转位置编码在注意力分数中引入了一种内在的距离相关偏差，这限制了RoPE建模长上下文的能力。RoPE扩展方法可以缓解这一问题，但它们通常需要在预训练后进行事后调整，例如重新缩放或超参数重新调优。本文提出了词元感知相位注意力（TAPA），这是一种新的位置编码方法，将可学习的相位函数融入到注意力机制中。TAPA能够在长距离上保持词元交互，通过直接且轻量的持续预训练即可扩展到更长的上下文，并能外推到未见过的长度，在长上下文场景中相比RoPE风格的基线方法实现了显著更低的困惑度和更强的检索性能。
tldr: 本文提出词元感知相位注意力（TAPA）这一新位置编码方法，通过在注意力机制中引入可学习的相位函数，克服了RoPE固有的距离相关偏差对长上下文建模的限制，只需轻量持续预训练即可扩展到更长上下文并取得更优性能。
